Concurrent crawling does not exceed max_pages limit even with high concurrency

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import crawl, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_concurrent=5, max_depth=1, max_pages=3)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(len(result.pages))

asyncio.run(main())
```
